pairs.locus: William of Tyre, Historia 10.14 (King Baldwin questions the Genoese consuls at Jaffa)
pairs.question: Utrum redeundi haberent propositum; aut servitio divino ad incrementum regni per tempus aliquod, honesto deputato salario, se velint mancipare?
pairs.answer: Quod si honestis conditionibus in regno possent moram facere, propositum eis erat, et fuerat ab initio, in Dei servitio ad incrementum regni fideliter per tempus aliquod desudare.
pairs.derivation: The king summons the Genoese consuls and leaders 'convenire facit, interrogans:' followed by the quoted question. Dropped the 'interrogans:' speech-tag framing as narration of the asking. The reply is introduced by 'responderunt:' (dropped as framing); the answer is taken as the single contiguous sentence to its full stop, which directly answers the question (they agree to stay and serve under honest conditions). Nothing trimmed internally; question and answer both verbatim, terminal punctuation normalized.
